question: Can a continuous state-function coefficient eta(X_U) multiplying the same minimal (D^2 Sigma)^2 operator be exactly silent in the quadratic cosmological RTK kernel for the entire rolling production branch while remaining nonzero at the exact local-rest point X_U=X_star?
production_identity: u=sqrt(X_U/X_star)=1+r with r=x/sqrt(1+lambda_D x^2)>0 on every finite-a rolling production state and r->0 as a->infinity, hence X_U->X_star from above
assumptions: the added operator is required to make exactly zero quadratic contribution to the RTK cosmological scalar kernel for every state on the full rolling production branch
no cancellation with distinct higher-spatial operators is invoked
target_logic: the linear/quadratic rolling-branch k^4 contribution from this operator is proportional to eta(X_bar) times a nonzero background factor
exact preservation of the cosmological RTK kernel therefore requires eta(X_bar)=0 for every X_bar in the continuous rolling interval above X_star
the rolling interval has X_star as an accumulation point
therefore this single continuous state-function coefficient cannot be exactly cosmology-silent and simultaneously provide a nonzero local-rest quadratic rescue
non_claims: does not rule out an approximately silent small coefficient such as the eta4 compatibility window already quantified
does not rule out cancellations among several independent higher-spatial operators
does not rule out operators whose cosmological projection vanishes structurally rather than by a state-function coefficient
does not rule out discontinuous/nonanalytic coefficients, although such choices require separate EFT and well-posedness justification
does not rule out a changed cosmological kernel followed by a new full likelihood refit
next_gate: search a minimal multi-operator or structurally FLRW-null higher-spatial basis; any claimed exact-silent rescue must evade one of the explicit assumptions of this no-go
